Signal detection assumes temporal precedence of data over market reaction, which fails if data is stale or misaligned. Methodological transparency ensures trust but risks overexposure of internal logic to adversarial agents. Cinematic voice acts as a stabilizing interface element, mitigating noise in communication channels. Failure modes include: delayed signal propagation, opaque reasoning paths, and stylistic inconsistencies that erode credibility. These primitives form a closed-loop system where GSI provides probabilistic inputs and GSE delivers contextualized outputs.
